annotations.title: Website screenshot API: capture any web page as an image

description: Website screenshot API: render any public web page in a real headless Chrome browser with JavaScript executed and get a JPEG screenshot (1280 px wide, base64) plus the final URL, HTTP status and title; fullPage=true captures up to 4000 px of height. Use for visual checks, previews, monitoring and archiving a page as an agent sees it. Example: url=https://example.com. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

fullPage.description: Set to true to capture the full page height (max 4000 px) instead of the 1280x800 viewport

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to capture

name: screenshot_website
title: Website screenshot API: capture any web page as an image
